skill.summary: Google Forms API integration with managed OAuth. Create forms, add questions, export responses to Excel, and summarize response data. Use this skill when use...

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release: Seamless integration with the Google Forms API using managed OAuth and API key authentication via the Forms for Google Drive iOS App.
- Features include creating new forms, adding questions, listing and managing forms, retrieving and summarizing responses, and exporting results to Excel.
- Requires users to obtain a free API key from the companion iOS app for authentication.
- Includes detailed API reference, error handling guidance, and agent instructions for secure and user-friendly operation.
